crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin hits a four-month low near $62K
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC slid as far as $62,112 over the weekend as leveraged longs were wiped out, down over $10,000 in a week.

crypto_headlines.title: $230 billion wiped from crypto market cap in 24 hours
crypto_headlines.summary: Saturday's selloff took BTC down 6.74%, ETH 9.36%, BNB 9.34%, XRP 10.92% and SOL 11.79% over 24 hours.

crypto_headlines.title: Over $360 million liquidated in five minutes
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin fell under $65,000 and ETH under $1,800 Saturday afternoon ET as more than $360 million in positions were liquidated in five minutes.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin bounces back above $65,000
crypto_headlines.summary: Late Saturday night ET, BTC turned green and reclaimed $65,000, liquidating $130 million in shorts.

crypto_headlines.title: BitMine sits on a $9.7 billion unrealized loss
crypto_headlines.summary: BitMine's 6.07 million ETH is now worth about half of what it paid, a $9.7 billion paper loss.

crypto_headlines.title: Czech National Bank issues its first blockchain bonds
crypto_headlines.summary: The Czech central bank issued its first bonds on a blockchain ledger, after already testing BTC in its portfolio.

doginal_news.title: Snapback Dog #1492 changes hands
doginal_news.summary: WelshBullTrader picked up Doginal Dog #1492 with the Snapback trait, worn by 141 of the 10,000 dogs (1.41%), thanking Shield for a smooth trade.

doginal_news.title: DDCompanion: a community AI desk assistant
doginal_news.summary: DroMeta introduced DDCompanion, a portable AI desk assistant built by the community around the 10k pixel Doginal Dogs collection.

doginal_news.title: Legends Arena bracket crowns RusMetaX
doginal_news.summary: Friday night's free-entry, single-elimination Legends Arena ROTP bracket paid a $50 prize; RusMetaX took the title.

doginal_news.title: Championship registration closes tonight
doginal_news.summary: Registration for the DDLTCG DDMIAMI Championship closes at 12 AM ET Monday, Nov 16; each entry adds a Victorious Gary promo.

doginal_news.title: Pyth is at Breakpoint London
doginal_news.summary: Pyth checked in from Breakpoint with a golf-themed booth where visitors can test their putting.

doginal_news.title: PIRB on the CFTC and multi-source prices
doginal_news.summary: PIRB pointed to Pyth's 138+ publishers as the CFTC calls for robust multi-source prices.

notes: No new posts from @DDLTCG in the last 24 hours, and no news on Toot, Atlas or Boogie.
